verdict.rationale: FreshBooks publishes an official Node.js SDK in its own GitHub org that wraps the REST API, includes a pre-configured Express app with PassportJS authentication, and is backed by a first-party "Getting Started with FreshBooks NodeJS SDK" tutorial. The SDK sits on top of a broad, documented API surface (OAuth 2.0 scopes, invoices, expenses, payments, journal entries, reports, webhooks), and a Tools and Libraries page and Postman collection are also referenced. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond Node.js (the story asks for SDKs, plural), SDK-level reference docs or details on versioning and maintenance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK's quality.
